how_to_read_this: evidence_kind is 'executed' only where the cited file says a probe, predicate or verifier was actually run. 'source' means a file was read. The two are never mixed inside one claim.
Every number carries the denominator its source stated. Nothing was rounded and no percentage was recomputed from a rounded value.
A finding reported by two reviewers independently is marked so. A finding where two reviewers disagree is in the disagreements block with both positions.
A FAIL in acceptance.json is a property that does not hold. It is not the same as a live exploitable hole, and the per-finding 'not_claimed' fields say which is which.

the_ones_that_matter_most_to_you: The grant ceiling holds. Nesting a wider grant, an expired grant, a node asking for file.write and a node naming a path the user did not name all raise PermissionError (executed).
Evidence cannot be forged or borrowed through the finish decision. Invented, unverified, empty and verification_failed refs are all rejected (executed, isolated database).
Completion is a current-state claim, not a replay. Rewriting a file behind ARIES's back and replaying the identical finish returns met=False and demotes the step to 'stale' (executed).
The terminal-failure shortcut is scoped as you claim it is. Eight adversarial variants of the predicate; it fires only on the single supported file.read case (executed).
The privacy partition IS enforced in code, not merely configured. The reviewer's own earlier statement to the contrary is withdrawn (N-06).
route() is correct. The defect is that route() is not the gate the live engine uses (EVR-1).
The desktop window verifiers do NOT trust the shell's accepted=true reply; they re-read the compositor up to 10 times and the tile branch accepts no tolerance (executed).
File mutation verifiers are not satisfied by a planner-supplied hash: copy_bytes/move_bytes refuse unless the source really hashes to it (executed).

The automation runner has no unbounded retry loop, the worker honours automations.worker_enabled, may_run is NOT skipped on the Run-now/API/CLI paths, and may_run's hysteresis is not an unreachable threshold (executed).
aries/intelligence/inference.py does not exist; the privacy validation is in egress.py and generation.py:59-69.
The wake gate does NOT fire on prefixes: 'Ariana', 'arithmetic' and a mid-sentence 'Ari' were all refuted, and 'арамија' does not wake. The whole-word rule works; the token list is the defect.

Voice has NO privileged or shortcut route. Spoken input reaches the same submit function, planner, capability policy and verification recorder as a typed goal, and no policy function in the path even receives the origin.
_tell_voice_outcome is not a second self-triggering TTS path, and notifications are not spoken, so neither gives ARIES an unbounded way to put words on the loudspeakers.
operator.confirm_model_plans has NOT been turned off on this machine — refuted as of that reading, so the model branch does still freeze non-read effects.

interests.learn() cannot be coaxed into writing the user's weight column and SettingsService.learn() has no layer parameter at all: both guarantees are structural, and the reviewer attacked both and failed.

The learning loop does NOT reach planning, capability selection, context assembly, routing or approval, cannot create a topic it was never told about, and cannot lower news.relevance_threshold to make itself louder.
The automation circuit breaker, the health automation, damping and freezing are all refuted as rollback mechanisms — which is precisely why F-14 stands.

findings_ranked.title: REPAIRED AND RE-VERIFIED: all 19 blind fixture oracles and both broken setups fixed; 49/49 runnable cases now discriminate
findings_ranked.severity: repair completed and independently re-verified — not a defect

findings_ranked.title: The wake gate admits 'ара', a common Macedonian interjection, and the bare name reopens the microphone for 6 seconds with no second wake word
findings_ranked.severity: high — it contradicts the owner's explicit standing rule
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every sentence spoken in the room, by anyone, on a machine where aries-voice is active and holding the microphone right now.
findings_ranked.source: findings.json F-15 and raw/review_voice_path.json VOICE-01 and VOICE-02 — two reviewers, agreeing, with the executed halves divided between them and each saying which half is theirs.
findings_ranked.measured: EXECUTED wake_match() probe (no capture opened, no service touched): 'ара, што правиш' -> wakes, submits 'што правиш'; 'Harry, close the door' -> 'close the door'; 'Hari, install vscode' -> 'install vscode'; 'Ари.' -> wakes with an EMPTY remainder; 'арамија' and 'здраво како си' -> do not wake. VOICE-01's executed journal read: 2026-09-24T22:39:39 `· woken with no command: 'Ari.'` then 22:39:41 `✓ 'split to YouTube.' — Task queued (heard in 763ms, acted in 30ms)`; 22:39:56 then 22:40:04 the same shape. Journal denominators, all boots since 2026-09-24T22:32: 1372 lines, 641 `· not addressed`, 241 `· dropped`, 2 `· woken`, 131 counter lines, highest `[80 acted / 165 utterances]`.
findings_ranked.one_line_fix: Drop 'ара' and 'ary' from WAKE, and require the follow-up window's capture to parse as a command before submitting it.
findings_ranked.not_claimed: The whole-word rule itself works and the gate holds for the first utterance — 'арамија' does not wake. findings.json F-15 is explicit that the follow-on 6-second window is the other reviewer's executed proof, not its own. Four hypotheses were refuted and must not be re-raised: prefix matching, Latin-script 'ara' as a token, a privileged voice route, and a confidence threshold on the wake decision.

findings_ranked.title: A learned change can be shadowed but never removed: there is no rollback, automatic or manual
findings_ranked.severity: high — it decides whether Level 9 has a precondition at all
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every learned interest weight and the learned news.relevance_threshold, on a machine where the Learning Loop automation is one of the 7 registered.
findings_ranked.source: findings.json F-14 and raw/review_learning_loop.json finding L9-01 and question 6 — one reviewer executed the ratcheting behaviour, the other confirmed by source and corrected one claim.
findings_ranked.measured: aries/learning/history.py:212-224 release() has zero callers. No clear_learned() exists for AriesInterest.learned_weight and every reference to it across aries/ is a read. The only HTTP route for clearing a setting (aries/api/routes.py:256-264) passes Layer.USER. Nothing outside aries/learning/ references AriesLearningChange or AriesReversal, so nothing reads the loop's history to judge it; the automation's declared evaluation_metrics and reward_signals (aries/learning/automation.py:236-263) are read by no controller.
findings_ranked.one_line_fix: Expose clear() at Layer.LEARNED, add a clear_learned() for AriesInterest.learned_weight, and give release() its caller.
findings_ranked.not_claimed: findings.json F-14 corrects the sub-claim that SettingsService.clear 'hardcodes Layer.USER': service.py:157 takes layer as a parameter, so LEARNED is expressible — it is unreachable in practice, not hardcoded. Two candidate substitutes are refuted: the automation circuit breaker and the health automation do not revert learned changes, and damping and freezing are not a rollback.

findings_ranked.title: The per-pass cap is not a bound per unit time: identical evidence is re-applied every pass
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every learned interest weight and the learned relevance threshold. Theoretical ceiling max_step * 24 = 3.6 per day, i.e. full saturation of [0,1] within a day.
findings_ranked.measured: A single fixed 30-day fixture drove a topic weight 0.6 -> 0.998 in four passes and the relevance threshold 0.6 -> 0.95 (its ceiling) in five, with no new data. The oscillation guards never engage because the direction never changes, so damping stays 1.0 and the freeze never trips. Per-pass bound, which is real: delta = clamp((target-current)*confidence, +/- learning.max_step * damping), clamped to [0,1], 3dp; learning.max_step 0.15 (range 0.01-0.5); damping = 0.5 ** reversals; threshold step = max_step / 2 = 0.075 with hard ceiling 0.95. learning.interval_hours has a minimum of 1 and is not user_only.
findings_ranked.one_line_fix: Make propose() check what has already been applied from the same evidence window before proposing again.

findings_ranked.title: The FATIGUE path escapes every stated safety property at once
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Any established topic position. It is the one write path with no minimum-evidence gate, no confirmation requirement and no step cap.
findings_ranked.measured: A FATIGUE verdict (aries/learning/reversal.py:267-273) fires with (a) no learning.min_observations check, (b) no reversal_min_observations_factor, (c) no higher confidence level, (d) no reversal_confirmations and (e) no max_step or damping cap — it writes learned - learning.fatigue_step directly (default 0.05, range 0.01-0.3). Its only input is TopicEvidence.trend, which compares raw per-bucket POINT RATES with a 0.05 delta over buckets of as few as 3 observations: 'that is the 1 of 3 statistics.py is written to refuse, used as the sole decision input.'
findings_ranked.one_line_fix: Apply min_observations, the reversal confirmation count and the max_step/damping cap to the FATIGUE path as the ordinary path already does.

findings_ranked.title: Only 35 of 58 verifiers are independent, and the 0-contradictions result has a simpler explanation than the one the thesis gives
findings_ranked.severity: high as a qualification on the thesis; the reviewer's own label is 'HIGHEST VALUE OF THIS REVIEW — it revises a thesis conclusion, not just code'
findings_ranked.blast_radius: The thesis's central evidential claim, plus every downstream document that quotes it.
findings_ranked.measured: INDEPENDENT 35, SELF_REPORT 10, TRIVIAL 12, PLANNER_SUPPLIED 1, UNDETERMINED 0, of 58 enumerated from the live registry. Joined against the ledger: verified_steps_all_time 1004; 763 (76.0%) from capabilities outside the m14 registry, explicitly excluded rather than assumed good or bad; steps_through_the_registry 241; INDEPENDENT 98 of 241 = 40.7%; SELF_REPORT or TRIVIAL or PLANNER_SUPPLIED 143 of 241 = 59.3%.
findings_ranked.one_line_fix: Report verification coverage split by whether the verifier is falsifiable; state 98/241 = 40.7% independent on the registry path; present BOTH explanations for the null and say the data does not separate them.
findings_ranked.suggested_experiment: Re-run the suite with the 23 non-independent verifiers replaced by falsifiable ones and measure the contradiction rate. If it stays 0 the original explanation is supported; if it rises it is refuted.
findings_ranked.not_claimed: Not that the system is dishonest — the independent verifiers are genuinely rigorous. Not that the 763 legacy-path steps are unverified; they were not classified and no claim is made. Not that the contradiction rate would be non-zero with falsifiable verifiers everywhere; that is the experiment this finding calls for, not a result it provides.

findings_ranked.title: Both proactive gates are unreachable: every shipped automation is classified 'light'
findings_ranked.severity: high (PG-01); findings.json rates it informational and adds 'it hollows out Level 7'

findings_ranked.title: The resource condition gate fails OPEN when a sensor cannot be read
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every heavy workload class once one is declared; today nothing reaches it because of PG-01.
findings_ranked.source: raw/review_proactive_gates.json PG-02 and findings.json F-07 — one reviewer inspected, the other executed, and they agree.
findings_ranked.measured: With probe_thermal and probe_gpu raising OSError, measure() returned {temperature_celsius: null, temperature_unavailable: 'OSError: sensor gone', gpu_pct: null, gpu_unavailable: 'OSError: no gpu'} and may_run for heavy_cpu with power.allow_heavy_cpu=True returned allowed=true, code 'ok', reason 'within the limits that could be read; temperature unknown'. Guards are `is not None` at governor.py:364, :372, :380.
findings_ranked.one_line_fix: Fail closed for TEMPERATURE when the workload class watches it, or require an explicit setting to proceed without a thermal reading.
findings_ranked.not_claimed: It is disclosed, not hidden: governor.py:385-391 builds a caveats list naming the unavailable sensor. The reviewer's point is that disclosure is not refusal. A second, unmeasured hazard is named and not claimed as a finding: there is no plausibility bound on readings that do arrive, so a stuck sensor at 0 degC reads as a cool machine.

findings_ranked.title: An 'over_budget' hold is released by a thermal criterion that has nothing to do with it
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every budgeted workload class once one is declared; the class-wide hold, not one job.
findings_ranked.source: raw/review_proactive_gates.json PG-03, with PG-04 as the second mechanism
findings_ranked.measured: active_hold (governor.py:266) treats both 'deferred' and 'over_budget' as active; release_holds (governor.py:279-312) only ever evaluates TEMPERATURE. Proven: an over_budget hold on heavy_cpu with the thermal probe pinned at 40 degC was released on tick 2 — about 2 minutes at the 60 s cadence — while the job still runs past its budget. PG-04: a 'deferred' hold was released on the FIRST tick once probe_thermal raised, bypassing the 5 degC resume margin and the 2-check streak.
findings_ranked.one_line_fix: Release a hold by the condition that created it; release_holds currently knows only one condition.
findings_ranked.not_claimed: The normal thermal resume path is correct and was proved correct at a steady 74 degC against a ceiling of 80-5=75 with clear_checks=2. This is not the Entry 010 unreachable-threshold trap.

findings_ranked.title: Capability verdicts that cannot return met=False
findings_ranked.severity: high (verifier-integrity F1); findings.json F-06 rates it 'low as a defect, HIGH as a qualification on the thesis claim'; EVR-3 low; CR-04 moderate
findings_ranked.blast_radius: 12 of 58 capabilities by the fullest count; 6 of those via the verify_probe factory. 47 of 1004 verified steps all-time = 4.7%.

findings_ranked.title: The echo guard presented as the replacement for the removed playback suppression is inert in the normal flow
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every capture that follows ARIES speaking.
findings_ranked.measured: echoes_own_speech() is applied only when audio_is_playing() is true (voice.py:573), but speak() is blocking (:534) and the player has exited before the next listen() begins, so the precondition is normally False. findings_ranked.title: Nothing content-based covers audio ARIES started but did not synthesise — the exact 2026-09-29 vector

findings_ranked.title: A queued child can be admitted to run after its parent has been cancelled; claim() never checks the parent's state
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Team children are read-only and path-exact, so the damage there is unrequested reads after the user said stop. The same claim() also admits the static fan-out path, where a sub-goal may hold any capability including mutating and desktop ones.
findings_ranked.measured: With a parent WorkspaceGoal row in state 'cancelled', goal_graph.dependencies_ready returned (True, None) for a child whose prerequisite had reached 'done' with final_evidence_refs AND for a child with no declared dependencies. Reproduction script is in the finding.

findings_ranked.not_claimed: The race window itself was reasoned about, not measured: within one tick the roll_up-then-claim ordering is safe under service._lock, but service.cancel does not take that lock. Latent for the team path behind ARIES_GOAL_TEAMS; reachable on the static fan-out path. The existing test covers only the pre-creation case (tests/test_goal_graph.py:109).

findings_ranked.title: validate() admits a decomposition whose node order does not match the root requirement order, and synthesize() can then never verify it
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every compound goal routed through a team. The model chooses node order, so 'done' versus 'partial' is nondeterministic for the same goal.
findings_ranked.measured: For 'Read <a> and read <b>' with root requirements [a, b], validate ACCEPTED nodes declared [read b, read a]; completion over the children's steps in synthesize order returned met=False ('No current verified evidence satisfies {"capability": "file.read", "path": "<a>"}'), and the same steps in root-requirement order returned met=True.
findings_ranked.one_line_fix: Either make validate require the node order to realise the root requirement order, or make synthesize order the concatenated steps by the root contract rather than by node declaration.
findings_ranked.not_claimed: Latent: ARIES_GOAL_TEAMS defaults FALSE and is the one flag currently off. Both of your team tests happen to declare nodes in requirement order, so this is invisible to them — that is an observation about the tests, not an accusation.

findings_ranked.title: Specialist grants come from model-proposed capabilities and the union of all goal paths, not from each node's validated requirements
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every team node. Executed: one node received all six SAFE_READS plus both goal paths, and could then read the sibling's file and enumerate processes.
findings_ranked.measured: validate() issued caps ['file.exists','file.list','file.read','system.processes','system.status','system.storage'] and paths ['/tmp/a.txt','/tmp/b.txt'] to a node whose only checkable requirement was file.read of /tmp/a.txt; under that grant scopes.enforce ALLOWED system.processes {}, system.status {} and file.read {'path':'/tmp/b.txt'}, and blocked only file.list /tmp and file.read /etc/passwd. Second proof: with an unsupported root contract, validate accepted two nodes doing 'List running processes' and 'Check system status', because the root cross-check at goal_graph.py:79 is guarded by root_contract['supported'].
findings_ranked.one_line_fix: Derive each node's grant from its own validated requirements rather than from its declared capabilities and the goal-wide path set, and run the root cross-check even when the root contract is unsupported.
findings_ranked.not_claimed: The ceiling holds — that was separately executed-proved. This is a least-privilege defect inside the ceiling, not an escape, and the flag is off by default. 'Do not add tasks the user did not ask for' exists only in the prompt.

findings_ranked.title: _propose_threshold double-counts multi-topic items, inflating n and overstating confidence
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every news.relevance_threshold proposal, which is the one setting the loop can change.
findings_ranked.measured: shown and dismissed sum PER-TOPIC slices (aries/learning/loop.py:284-288) while gather() increments one slice per topic per item (evidence.py:167-177), so an item matching k topics contributes k. EXECUTED on 10 real aries_news_items rows: shown 30, dismissed 30. The declared minimum of min_observations*2 = 20 can be met by 7 real items at k=3, and Proposal.confidence (= the Wilson interval's lower bound, computed on the inflated n) was 0.886 instead of 0.722.

findings_ranked.title: The loop's own governing knobs, including its master switch, are machine-writable at the LEARNED layer

findings_ranked.title: Human authorship is a caller-supplied string, so 'user:<anything>' obtains USER-layer authority and bypasses the user_only guard
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every setting, including the three user_only keys the reviewer wrote through: learning.apply_changes, autonomy.level and autonomy.max_actions_per_hour.

EXECUTED on three user_only keys via learn(set_by='user'): learning.apply_changes -> False, autonomy.level -> 'automated', autonomy.max_actions_per_hour -> 999.

findings_ranked.title: interests.update() has no author gate and records every actor as human

findings_ranked.title: The loop can silence the evidence that would contradict it
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Both of the loop's writable quantities, in both directions, with no way for the loop to undo its own quieting.
findings_ranked.measured: WEIGHT loop: learned_weight enters interests.profile() -> relevance score -> disposition at aries/news/automation.py:217 (score < news.relevance_threshold -> 'below_threshold'), and evidence.gather() counts ONLY disposition in ('delivered','held') (aries/learning/evidence.py:143-161), so lowering a topic's weight removes that topic's items from its own evidence. THRESHOLD loop: a raised threshold shrinks the evidence base globally and is UPWARD ONLY.

findings_ranked.not_claimed: The deliberate mitigation is real and correctly implemented in the opposite direction: never-shown items are excluded so the loop cannot confirm a guess with manufactured zero-engagement.

findings_ranked.title: status='degraded' resets the circuit breaker, so a permanently half-broken automation is never paused
findings_ranked.blast_radius: All 7 automations. runner.py:188-190 lets the automation body choose its own status and names System Health as reporting 'degraded' when a probe could not run, so this is a reachable configuration.

A 'skipped' row does not break the streak. One 'degraded' row after 5 failures reset the breaker to closed with streak 0. automations.breaker_threshold=0 disables it entirely.

findings_ranked.title: A blind thermal sensor releases an existing hold immediately, with no margin and no streak
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every thermal hold. Losing a sensor becomes the fastest possible way to clear one.

findings_ranked.not_claimed: The comment's reasoning is defensible and is quoted rather than dismissed: 'holding forever on a blind sensor would be the unreachable rule again'.

findings_ranked.title: A resource-policy or breaker refusal resets the pacing clock, costing a full interval

findings_ranked.title: An unrecognised workload name silently downgrades an automation to 'light'
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every workload declaration. A typo removes the gate with no log and no warning.

findings_ranked.title: Six browser action verifiers compare against the executor's own post-action observation, so a no-op action verifies

findings_ranked.title: screen.read verifies the picture, not the text
findings_ranked.blast_radius: screen.read. The fix needs no new machinery.

findings_ranked.title: verify_probe hardcodes met=True, so the completion recheck for every system.* requirement cannot fail

findings_ranked.severity: low as a defect, HIGH as a qualification on the thesis claim
findings_ranked.blast_radius: 6 capabilities, all effect=read: file.list, file.search, system.status, system.storage, system.processes, task.inspect. 47 of 1004 verified steps all-time = 4.7%.
findings_ranked.measured: verified_steps_all_time 1004; verified_by_a_verifier_that_cannot_fail 47; share 4.7%; verified_by_a_verifier_that_can_fail 957; from a read-only query over aries_workspace_goals.result_json in var/aries.db.

findings_ranked.title: Context items dropped for budget are not named, while omitted historical sections are

findings_ranked.title: Spoken input has no interpretation-confirmation step, and an approval freeze opens no window
findings_ranked.blast_radius: Every spoken goal. A typed user confirms first; a spoken one does not, and a frozen spoken goal is invisible on the dashboard.
